issues.description: Leaf `name`/`fileName` parameters are not validated for traversal. The official fix's core change (FileUtils.directoryTraversal on name/fileName, rejecting any "/" plus canonical check) is not replicated, so name="../evil" with a benign currentDir can still build a traversing fullName.

verifyFile (file upload) path is entirely unguarded. The official fix adds directoryTraversal checks on both `name` and `file.getOriginalFilename()`; our patch touches no upload path, leaving upload-based traversal open.
Mitigation is an ad-hoc ".."-segment/backslash blocklist rather than canonicalize-then-verify-within-base-dir, the CWE-022 defense of record; fragile against non-".." escape forms.
Unrelated artifact test/testFile.txt committed with the patch, adding noise unrelated to the security fix.

result.root_cause: Untrusted resource-center path inputs (currentDir, and especially the leaf name/fileName and uploaded originalFilename) are concatenated into fullName and passed to HadoopUtils' new Path() sink without canonicalization/containment validation, allowing path traversal.
result.summary: Our patch blocks the observed POV by adding a currentDir \"..\"-segment blocklist (directoryPathTraversal) at three service entry points, and regressions pass. However it guards the wrong/partial parameter: the official fix validates the leaf name/fileName and the uploaded originalFilename via directoryTraversal (reject any \"/\" + canonical vs absolute), whereas our patch never validates name/fileName and does not touch verifyFile — so leaf-name and upload traversal vectors of the same CWE-022 class remain reachable. It is a symptom-oriented, blocklist-based subset of the official fix rather than a root-cause, canonicalizing fix.
